report:
Reviewed the complete atomic_checking claim, its sole ordinary implementation association in unify.rs, and both associated tests. Independently verified exact byte equality of current unify.rs, method.rs and semantic_spec.rs against the supplied historical source snapshots; historical rationale is consistent with current evidence, but is not execution evidence.

The ordinary implementation establishes the short-lived probe boundary: try_unify_batch performs every equality in one child; try_probe rebuilds and collapses that child only on complete success, directly into the supplied parent, and discards it on error. Recursive matching and universe/bound changes use that child version. The referenced RFD distinguishes this direct-parent commit from concurrent candidates, which extract responses from isolated contexts instead of merging candidate state into a requester; it also specifies frozen ancestry, unique variable identities and the sole-live-child commit prerequisite. These qualifications remain part of the deferred full matrix, rather than a claim that the single helper proves every candidate path.

The complete ordinary test external_method_mismatch_discards_partial_generic_bindings meaningfully checks an error, unchanged caller bound and unchanged root semantic revision after a late argument mismatch. Captured SignatureTcx fixture has generic first parameter E and Boolean second parameter; the call supplies an inference variable then Char, so this really exercises partial generic matching before rejection. Captured instantiate_external_inherent_signature stages matches in a child and discards before its success-only commit/publication path. This would catch leaked generic equality or semantic revision. Its empty predicate fixture does not demonstrate obligation publication or absence of leaked obligations, and its assertions do not independently establish all wake/sibling scenarios.

The associated todo::inference_atomic_checking explicitly retains the remaining verification matrix: rejection after partial matching, successful exactly-once staged obligation publication, and sibling candidates with distinct inference identities. Rejection now has a substantive example; full successful/rejected wake and obligation observation and sibling isolation remain deferred under this matrix. Completing it requires obligation-bearing candidate fixtures, observable parent wake/publication state on both outcomes, and simultaneous sibling contexts with distinct variables. The empty TODO body is no behavioral evidence. Thus isolated staging, all-or-discard, direct-parent rules, and nonleakage of equality/wakes/obligations are accounted for as the inspected example plus explicit remaining verification work, not complete coverage. No new source defect was identified and no edits are requested to this justified deferred accounting.

Execution: personally ran review start/read and exact-byte comparison, then recorded this report. No tests or workspace build were executed by this reviewer. The coordinator reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and a successful root build separately; neither is treated as this reviewer's execution or evidence that the deferred scenarios ran.
